__NOTOC__
<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="sanctum-of-rebirth-hard-mode-mechanics" class="pvme-source-title"><ins><nowiki>Sanctum of Rebirth Hard Mode Mechanics</nowiki></ins></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/6SFXGZ90Rz.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The Sanctum of Rebirth is a boss dungeon set in the Underworld. Formerly owned by Amascut, three soul devourer bosses can be fought after completion of the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Soul_Searching <nowiki>Soul Searching</nowiki>]<nowiki> miniquest. This guide focuses on the boss's rotations and mechanics for the </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Hard Mode</nowiki></strong><nowiki> version. Only in Hard Mode is the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Shard_of_Genesis_Essence <nowiki>Shard of Genesis Essence</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266418218264694954.png?v=1" alt="shardofgenesisessence" title="shardofgenesisessence" kind="icon" /><nowiki> dropped that upgrades Tier 95 weapons to Tier 100.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="vermyx-brood-mother"><ins><nowiki>Vermyx, Brood Mother</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/jaS1tXIXjM.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="auto-attacks"><ins><nowiki>Auto-attacks</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Vermyx uses both </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/C31eiH1xcj.mp4 <nowiki>Melee</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/yDjvHTmoY8.mp4 <nowiki>Ranged</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> auto-attacks, while Coilspawns only attack with Ranged </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Auto-attacks cause 2% armour break per successful hit</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Every auto-attack Vermyx's adren bar fills by 50%, starting a new mechanic when full.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Starts at 4 Brood Mother Bond stacks in HM</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ 15% extra damage dealt by Vermyx per coilspawn alive</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ You can flank </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088296157185.png?v=1" alt="flank4" title="flank4" kind="icon" /><nowiki> by standing right next to Vermyx's head.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="vermyx-rotation"><ins><nowiki>Vermyx Rotation</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-1-start-600kplayer"><nowiki>Phase 1 (start: 600k/player)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>3 autos →</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>Moonstone Shards → 2 autos → Wyrmfire + 2 autos → repeat</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-2-start-450kplayer"><nowiki>Phase 2 (start: 450k/player)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>3 autos →</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>Moonstone shards → 2 autos → Soul Bomb → 1 auto + bomb hit (in that order) → 1 auto → Wyrmfire → 8 autos + Scarab Healer → Moonstone Shards</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-3-start-300kplayer"><nowiki>Phase 3 (start: 300k/player)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>3 autos → Scarab Healer (+ autos continue) → 3 autos → Moonstone shards → 2 autos → Soul Bomb → 1 auto + bomb hit (in that order) → 1 auto → Wyrmfire → 7 autos + Scarab Healer → Wyrmfire</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="vermyx-mechanics"><ins><nowiki>Vermyx Mechanics</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="moonstone-shards"><nowiki>Moonstone shards</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Vermyx will shout </nowiki><code><nowiki>Snaaaarl!</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎then the following pop-up will appear: </nowiki><code><nowiki>Shards of moonstone mark your feet. Prepare to move!</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎sprouting moonstone shards (10.5k LP)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Three appear per player</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Hits 4k typeless if not evaded</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Binds, stuns, and disables protection prayers for 2 seconds</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Next shard location is aimed 1t after former (1-2 squares away)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Blocks movement, line-of-sight, and persists through the remainder of the fight unless killed</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ To deal with this mechanic, move out of the way of the light blue sections which will appear underneath you</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pvme-video src="https://img.pvme.io/images/L7ucraCzQO.mp4" controls="1" loop="1" muted="1" type="video/mp4" />
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="soul-rush"><nowiki>Soul Rush</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Vermyx will shout </nowiki><code><nowiki>Rarghh!</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎then the following popup will appear: </nowiki><code><nowiki>Vermyx channels power from the Sanctum towards the west/east.</nowiki></code><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Green arrows will appear to indicate where to stand to redirect the soul: it will always be 3 souls per player), and the west side will always be first</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ These appear 1.2 seconds faster in HM.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Directly after redirecting the souls, Vermyx reappears and the next phase starts.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Shortly after the third set of green arrows appear, that section of the room gets Wyrmfire. An example of this mechanic can be seen </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/KS7S2YftJk.mp4 <nowiki>here</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ To deal with this mechanic, focus on redirecting souls by standing between the green arrows</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Coilspawns will respawn once per side if you kill them and the phase will keep </nowiki><strong><nowiki>repeating until </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/egjbOb6Z5w.png <nowiki>3 souls are redirected</nowiki>]<nowiki> (3 per player per phase)</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Killing the Coilspawn will speed up the redirecting souls for the next rotation.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pvme-video src="https://img.pvme.io/images/Sm2yDvZCdG.mp4" controls="1" loop="1" muted="1" type="video/mp4" />
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="wyrmfire"><nowiki>Wyrmfire</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Vermyx stops auto-attacking and any of the heads can start using AoE breath attacks.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ West and East Coilspawn use a breath attack that goes across the middle of the arena.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Vermyx, NW Coilspawn, and NE Coilspawn use a 19x19 AoE breath attack</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• After Soul Rush, Wyrmfire is guaranteed and only in:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/KS7S2YftJk.mp4 <nowiki>Northwest</nowiki>]<nowiki> (phase 1-2)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/aiq08Q48Mi.mp4 <nowiki>Northeast</nowiki>]<nowiki> (phase 2-3)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If not after Soul Rush, all alive heads </nowiki><strong><nowiki>including Vermyx</nowiki></strong><nowiki> will Wyrmfire in an unknown order</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pvme-video src="https://img.pvme.io/images/xkICDlIRJY.mp4" controls="1" loop="1" muted="1" type="video/mp4" />
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="corrupted-scarab-healer"><nowiki>Corrupted Scarab Healer</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Vermyx will say </nowiki><code><nowiki>Heaaall…</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎and a corrupted Scarab Healer (15k LP) will spawn on the outer edge of the arena, making its way to Vermyx</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ One per player</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Stun to damage it</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The spawn does not delay Vermyx's autos</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Heals Vermyx by double its remaining LP when its overhead bar is full</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pvme-video src="https://img.pvme.io/images/9BViB5bz2L.mp4" controls="1" loop="1" muted="1" type="video/mp4" />
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="soul-bomb"><nowiki>Soul Bomb</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Vermyx will shout </nowiki><code><nowiki>Kreeee!</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎and the following pop-up will appear: </nowiki><code><nowiki>Vermyx fires a Soul bomb. Ready yourself!</nowiki></code><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Vermyx will point her head up and fire two 8k soft typeless targeted hits per player, telegraphed on the ground.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• These target the ground and will hit anything in a 3x3 area.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• To deal with this mechanic: move out of the way of the light blue sections which will appear underneath you</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pvme-video src="https://img.pvme.io/images/9cDGUDXTi5.mp4" controls="1" loop="1" muted="1" type="video/mp4" />
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="kezalam-the-wanderer"><ins><nowiki>Kezalam, the Wanderer</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/Td120qtp1z.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>*⬥ Uses </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> autos</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Can be stunned (delays rotation)*</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="kezalam-rotation"><ins><nowiki>Kezalam Rotation</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Every auto-attack gives it 25% adren, at 100% she uses her next mechanic. Adren carries over between phases.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-1-start-900kplayer"><nowiki>Phase 1 (start: 900k/player)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Note: Kezalam starts at 100% adren.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>SB-Scattered → Moonstone Prison + Soul Bomb → SB-Targeted → SB-Scattered → Unstable Scarabs → SB-Targeted → repeat</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-2-start-600kplayer"><nowiki>Phase 2 (start: 600k/player)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Note: First P2 mechanic is based on last P1 mechanic.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>Kill Moonstone Obelisk →</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>SB-Line → SB-Targeted → Unstable Scarabs → SB-Line → SB-Targeted → Moonstone Prison + Soul Bomb → repeat</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-3-start-300kplayer_1"><nowiki>Phase 3 (start: 300k/player)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Note: First P3 mechanic is based on last P2 mechanic.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>Kill Moonstone Obelisk →</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>Moonstone Prison + Soul Bomb → SB-Line → SB-Scattered → Moonstone Prison + Soul Bomb → SB-Line → SB-Targeted → repeat</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="kezalam-mechanics"><ins><nowiki>Kezalam Mechanics</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="sanctum-blast-scattered"><nowiki>Sanctum Blast - Scattered</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Kezalam shouts </nowiki><code><nowiki>Dhaaarken</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎and the Sanctum blasts the floor in a wide area.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Always spawn under whoever holds aggro and is based on their location</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• There are safespots for this mechanic</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pvme-video src="https://img.pvme.io/images/p57xqyhi2p.mp4" controls="1" loop="1" muted="1" type="video/mp4" />
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="sanctum-blast-targeted"><nowiki>Sanctum Blast - Targeted</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Kezalam shouts and the Sanctum blasts the floor three times in a row.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ sections always appear under whoever holds aggro, based on their location. They appear back-to-back-to-back</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><code><nowiki>Graaah</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎= sections under her, Kezalam spins</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><code><nowiki>Kyaaa</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎= sections surround her, Kezalam crouches</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><code><nowiki>Hrrrr</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎= sections far out, Kezalam crouches</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Deals soft typeless damage (5-7k)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/ba7cwLBSy5.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
</nowiki><em><nowiki>Kyaaa (left), Graaah (middle), Hrrrr (right)</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="moonstone-prison-soul-bomb"><nowiki>Moonstone Prison + Soul Bomb</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Each player is stunned and imprisoned in moonstone shards (10.5k LP), with a Soul Bomb descending on them.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Soul Bomb hits 9k soft typeless in a 3x3 area if not away</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Blocks movement, line-of-sight, and persists during the remainder of the fight</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="unstable-scarabs"><nowiki>Unstable Scarabs</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Kezalam summons scarabs </nowiki><code><nowiki>Erggg...</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎into the arena.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Volatile scarab akhs (3k LP), two per player.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Stun to damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Explode when overhead bar is full, dealing 6-7k soft typeless damage to all players.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="sanctum-blast-line"><nowiki>Sanctum Blast - Line</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Kezalam shouts </nowiki><code><nowiki>Paiiin</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎and the Sanctum blasts a line on the arena towards the player</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Every player gets one, in order</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/1lcLVSvIBf.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
</nowiki><em><nowiki>Moonstone Prison + Soul Bomb (upper-left), Unstable Scarabs (upper-right), and SB-Line (bottom)</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="moonstone-obelisk-and-wave"><nowiki>Moonstone Obelisk and Wave</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>When you reach the phase HP, the Moonstone Obelisks at the edges become damageable (90k LP per player)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Each obelisk up heals Kez 9k LP every 3 seconds</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Moonstone obelisks face outward and can be flanked </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088296157185.png?v=1" alt="flank4" title="flank4" kind="icon" /><nowiki> easily.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If failed to destroy after 25s (40t), the obelisks becomes invulnerable again and Kezalam retaliates</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• A Soulfire Wave goes back and forth over the arena. This wave is </nowiki><strong><nowiki>not</nowiki></strong><nowiki> telegraphed</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Deals 8k soft typeless damage. Can be safespotted behind the obelisk</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ In groups you can skip the P2-3 transition by killing both Moonstone Obelisks in the P1-2 transition.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Obelisks need to be killed at roughly the same time (~1 GCD) for this to work</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pvme-video src="https://img.pvme.io/images/CNAUnABCQQ.mp4" controls="1" loop="1" muted="1" type="video/mp4" />
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="nakatra-devourer-eternal"><ins><nowiki>Nakatra, Devourer Eternal</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/VB3iwFqYtA.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>*⬥ HM starts at 200 corruptive stacks, that increase her typed damage (autos, waves, obliterate)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Switches between </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> autos after each set</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Each auto gives 33% adren</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Nakatra uses a mechanic every time her adren bar is full. In phase 3 and 4 however, mechanics are mostly time-based*</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="nakatra-rotation"><ins><nowiki>Nakatra Rotation</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-1-start-1200kplayer"><nowiki>Phase 1 (start: 1200k/player)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Nakatra says </nowiki><code><nowiki>I am afraid this is where your story ends.</nowiki></code><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>2 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> autos → Soulfire Wave → 3 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> autos →</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>Obliterate → 3 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> autos → Soulfire Wave → 3 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> autos → Soulfire Wave + Summon Scarabs → 1 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> auto → Soulfire Wave → 3 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> autos → repeat</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-2-start-960kplayer"><nowiki>Phase 2 (start: 960k/player)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Nakatra says </nowiki><code><nowiki>The sanctum is mine to control.</nowiki></code><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>2 sections →</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>3 autos → Obliterate → Soulfire Wave → 3 autos → 2 Sanctum Hieroglyphs → 3 autos → Soulfire Wave + Summon Scarabs → 3 autos → 2 Sanctum Hieroglyphs → repeat</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-3-start-480kplayer"><nowiki>Phase 3 (start: 480k/player)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Nakatra says </nowiki><code><nowiki>The Sanctum will protect me while I only grow stronger.</nowiki></code><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Summon Nefthys +</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>Soulfire Crosswave → Soulfire Wave → Soulfire Crosswave → Soulfire Wave → Heal Nefthys → repeat</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-4-start-480kplayer"><nowiki>Phase 4 (start: 480k/player)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>After the last Nefthys dies, Nakatra shouts </nowiki><code><nowiki>Suffer the full power of the Sanctum!</nowiki></code><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>Shadowsands → 3 autos + Sanctum Shockwave → Obliterate → 3 Sanctum Hieroglyphs → Soulfire Wave → 3 Sanctum Hieroglyphs → repeat</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="nakatra-mechanics"><ins><nowiki>Nakatra Mechanics</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="obliterate"><nowiki>Obliterate</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Nakatra says </nowiki><code><nowiki>Prepare for death…</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎&amp; </nowiki><code><nowiki>Be obliterated!</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎before blasting you three times with a ramping </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> hit.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ How to deal with it:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1" alt="deflectmage" title="deflectmage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1" alt="reflect" title="reflect" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1" alt="debil" title="debil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537341954392850442.png?v=1" alt="shielddome" title="shielddome" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Damage-forward option: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1" alt="reflect" title="reflect" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462694912.png?v=1" alt="reprisal" title="reprisal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1" alt="powerburstofvitality" title="powerburstofvitality" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1" alt="divert" title="divert" kind="icon" /><nowiki> the </nowiki><strong><nowiki>second</nowiki></strong><nowiki> hit. </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1" alt="divert" title="divert" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is riskier</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pvme-video src="https://img.pvme.io/images/Y7CzDkN4sS.mp4" controls="1" loop="1" muted="1" type="video/mp4" />
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1" alt="reflect" title="reflect" kind="icon" /><nowiki> method example </nowiki>[https://youtu.be/G9Nf8pPd8bQ?t=1565 <nowiki>here</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="soulfire-wave"><nowiki>Soulfire Wave</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Nakatra says </nowiki><code><nowiki>The soulfire erases all.</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎and two soulfire waves will run over the arena in bands (West-East or South-North), dealing magic damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Position yourself between the two wave edges to step out of the way.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Alternatively, you can </nowiki>[https://youtu.be/Q7BAS0xSvbw <nowiki>run</nowiki>]<nowiki> (or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1" alt="dive" title="dive" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> ) through them</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ This mechanic has 50% defensive penetration (excl. </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki>)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="summon-scarabs"><nowiki>Summon Scarabs</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Two scarabs can be summoned during a Soulfire Wave mechanic.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Stun to damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Volatile scarab akh (3k LP)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Stationary</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Explodes when overhead bar is full, dealing 6-7k typeless damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Corrupted scarab healer (15k LP)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Moves towards Nakatra</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Heals her by double its remaining LP when its overhead bar is full</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>when overhead bar is full</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pvme-video src="https://img.pvme.io/images/WYhCcEMaz6.mp4" controls="1" loop="1" muted="1" type="video/mp4" />
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Soulfire Waves and Summon Scarabs</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="sanctum-hieroglyphs"><nowiki>Sanctum Hieroglyphs</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Nakatra shouts </nowiki><code><nowiki>Feel the power beneath your feet!</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎or </nowiki><code><nowiki>Face judgement foul wretch.</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎and she divides the arena in 3x3 sections, of which 3-8 sections are about to be blasted.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Locations are foretold by one of sixteen hieroglyphs on sides of the arena, up high. Picture them as they fall face down onto the arena. The sections that are safe are highlighted. See </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/cQUSEsZ3Hr.png <nowiki>here</nowiki>]<nowiki> for an overview of hieroglyphs and how they apply to the arena.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• First: west wall hieroglyph</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Second: east wall hieroglyph</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Third: north wall hieroglyph (P4 only)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ How to handle: Stand as shown in the picture. Northeast and Southwest are the best corners for Phases 1-2, Southwest corner is the best for phase 4. Stand on purple (other in the image) ready to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. When the mechanic starts:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• One of the adjacent four red sections (42/48 chance) is safe to move onto, or</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The section diagonally across (6/48 chance) is safe: use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1" alt="dive" title="dive" kind="icon" /><nowiki> from purple to reach the other side. </nowiki><strong><nowiki>keep attacking Nakatra so you face her again</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Repeat as necessary.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If you don't get hit, your mobility ability's ( </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1" alt="dive" title="dive" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1" alt="escape" title="escape" kind="icon" /><nowiki> ) cooldowns is reset</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Hits up to 8k hard typeless damage through defences, putting them on cooldown.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/fdcq47Yuzl.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="summon-nefthys"><nowiki>Summon Nefthys</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/C3YD1odWuK.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
At the start of phase 3, Nakatra shouts </nowiki><code><nowiki>Nefthys!</nowiki></code><nowiki>; summons Nefthys, the Split Soul (90k LP); and becomes immune to all damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Two are summoned per player, at 75% adren.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Deals melee damage in halberd-distance</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ When you move out of halberd-distance Nefthys howls (blue bar fills up) he takes reduced damage, go halberd-distance to stop it and reset the bar.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When the blue bar is full, Nakatra gains +50 stacks (line: </nowiki><code><nowiki>RAAR!</nowiki></code><nowiki>)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ When their adren bar is full, the next attack disables protection prayers.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="heal-nefthys"><nowiki>Heal Nefthys</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Nakatra says </nowiki><code><nowiki>Be healed!</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎or </nowiki><code><nowiki>Nefthys, be retored.</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎and heals all Nefthys at once for 45k LP.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ This occurs roughly every 22 seconds.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="soulfire-crosswave"><nowiki>Soulfire Crosswave</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Nakatra blasts the arena with an eight-pointed Soulfire crosswave from the centre while Nefthys are alive.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Nefthys and star wave </nowiki>[https://youtu.be/DhCuBYnVC4Q?t=660 <nowiki>video example</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="shadowsands-devour"><nowiki>Shadowsands Devour</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>When all Nefthys are dead, Nakatra shouts </nowiki><code><nowiki>Suffer the full power of the Sanctum!</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎&amp; </nowiki><code><nowiki>The Devourer will consume you soul!</nowiki></code><nowiki>, and you get dragged to the Shadowsands. Leave within 30 seconds or you get hard instakilled </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1104794644497309809.png?v=1" alt="instakill" title="instakill" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Release the Soul Storm in MD (</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="deflectmelee" title="deflectmelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for the gorillas)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Kill the Shadowsands feline akh (22.5k LP, 2/player in solo)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Remember the two shown hieroglyphs next to the Devourer</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• These are personal</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Four hieroglyphs if it's the fourth time being devoured</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Recover the three soul fragments to go back</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Back outside, Nakatra says </nowiki><code><nowiki>Impossible...</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎or </nowiki><code><nowiki>WHAT ARE YOU</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎&amp; </nowiki><code><nowiki>Your death is inevitable.</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎Prepare for the incoming barrage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Nakatra takes reduced damage for ~10 seconds and gains +50 stacks</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ How to handle: Step on the hieroglyph that was not shown in the shadowsands to block the barrage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This is personal: Group members might have a different location!</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If failed: The barrage deals heavy typeless and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> damage every 0.6 seconds for 1.8 seconds. Nakatra gains +10 stacks for each barrage hit.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• How to handle: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258538582017.png?v=1" alt="immort" title="immort" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> only reduces damage)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/wPvwi9WPG9.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
</nowiki><em><nowiki>All possible shadowsands hieroglyphs</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://youtu.be/DhCuBYnVC4Q?t=710 <nowiki>Video example of phase 4</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="sanctum-shockwave"><nowiki>Sanctum Shockwave</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>As Nakatra shouts </nowiki><code><nowiki>You cannot stop me!</nowiki></code><nowiki>, concentric shockwaves spread from under her to the arena's edge.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ This happens twice back-to-back</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You will also get 3 autos during this mechanic.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Each blast comes in four consecutive hard typeless hits: 4-3-3-3 squares, measured from Nakatra to the edge</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Breaks through defences and puts them on cooldown.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ How to handle, two ways:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pvme-video src="https://img.pvme.io/images/3BkZgA2Lut.mp4" controls="1" loop="1" muted="1" type="video/mp4" />
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1" alt="escape" title="escape" kind="icon" /><nowiki> method (more forgiving)</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pvme-video src="https://img.pvme.io/images/BKKuoNp0LM.mp4" controls="1" loop="1" muted="1" type="video/mp4" />
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Tilestep method (staying in </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1" alt="deathskulls" title="deathskulls" kind="icon" /><nowiki> range)</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Further Notes:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Nakatra deals a lot of high damage that (partially) ignore defensives. When learning, it might be helpful to use forms of damage mitigation that </nowiki><strong><nowiki>do</nowiki></strong><nowiki> work:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Death ward relic </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697808774068699286.png?v=1" alt="deathward" title="deathward" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Aegis aura </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1204128299241177148.png?v=1" alt="aegis" title="aegis" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Hellhound familiar </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226475925514.png?v=1" alt="hellhoundpouch" title="hellhoundpouch" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Powerburst of Vitality </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1" alt="powerburstofvitality" title="powerburstofvitality" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Spirit shields </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148977577059430461.png?v=1" alt="spectralspiritshield" title="spectralspiritshield" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as an emergency swap</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ P2 Scarab healers can heal Nakatra on P3. This 30k LP can be removed again to reach the cap HP.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ P3 Nakatra is briefly fully damageable (~2 GCDs) after killing the last Nefthys, the moment her adren bar is full again.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• One can try to prephase with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1" alt="volleyofsouls" title="volleyofsouls" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809262194294864.png?v=1" alt="deathguard70" title="deathguard70" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to make P4 faster.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Shadowsands gorilla akh do not need to be killed, but if killed they do not reappear.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
